ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Using the diagram, what term best describes the cuttlefish?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram. On the right side there is a box labeled “Cuttlefish”, and multiple arrows point to it, including arrows coming from the directions of organisms such as “Crabs”, “Goby Fish”, “Butterfly Fish”, and “Tiny Shrimps”. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows indicate energy flowing from the organism being eaten to the organism eating it. Because arrows from multiple animals point to cuttlefish, it shows that cuttlefish eats these animals. Therefore, the term that best describes cuttlefish is predator.
